svg.title: Section: the High Peaks
svg.desc: Book III climb, 2 800 to 4 600 m: ice schist and crystal vein under a violet dusk, the 4 000 m line ruled across with the low-gravity shimmer above it, storm rock ringed in red on the route and three camps.
svg.text: SECTION B3 HIGH PEAKS 2 800 to 4 600 m
